BEFORE A VISIT OR TASK

Agree the details
that matter.

  • Property and purpose: location, stage, concerns and the questions to answer.
  • Permission and access: who can authorise visits, hold keys and communicate on your behalf.
  • Scope and timing: visit frequency, coordination period, reports and next update.
  • Costs and approvals: our quote, separately scoped specialists and spending limits.
  • Boundaries: what a practical check can establish, what it cannot and how unresolved items are handled.

REPORTING WITH CONTEXT

Every update should
make the picture clearer.

Observed: what was visible during an authorised visit.

Reported: information provided by a seller, developer, contractor or management team.

Specialist findings: assessments by the separately engaged professional, within their scope.

Still open: unanswered questions, access limits and work awaiting agreed evidence or reinspection.

THE RIGHT HELP, CLEAR RESPONSIBILITIES

Practical care.
Specialist expertise when needed.

Baanward handles practical property coordination. Walailak Law Firm separately handles legal advice, legal due diligence, contracts and legal representation, subject to its own conflict checks and engagement.

Technical inspections and certification need an appropriately scoped specialist. We help coordinate that input and keep responsibilities clear.

We ask your permission before a legal referral. The firm completes its acceptance process before receiving a substantive legal file. Specialist fees are separately scoped unless expressly included.
